# `aitbc system status`

Get system status from the coordinator API, or full systemctl status for a service.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | no | Show full systemctl status for a specific service |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system status
```
